result.title: PsyWorld: Profile-Conditioned World Modeling for Human Behavior Prediction
result.comment: Accepted to the KDD 2027 AI for Sciences Track
result.summary: Understanding how stable psychometric traits and time-varying states jointly inform behavior is an important problem in computational behavioral science. Existing personalized agents commonly condition actions directly on a static profile, leaving realized state transitions unused as an explicit source of supervision. We introduce a profile-conditioned state world model that uses observed environment--behavior state transitions to learn transition-informed representations for behavioral prediction. During training, a posterior encoder quantizes realized transitions, while a prior predicts the resulting codes from the psychometric profile and pre-transition context. The prior code and predicted next state then condition macro-level behavior and simulator-grounded execution. Thus, the world model provides structured transition supervision instead of treating personality as a direct action descriptor. We evaluate the framework in VEET, a controlled behavioral simulator with human trajectories, and in AgentSociety as a structurally different synthetic environment. A participant-disjoint split of 240 training, 25 validation, and 48 test participants evaluates generalization to unseen people. On VEET, the model reaches 0.904 Top-1 accuracy (95\% CI: [0.895, 0.913]) and 0.0033 Macro KL. Ablations associate continuous next-state modeling with most of the Top-1 gain, while discrete codes and prior alignment mainly improve Top-3 and distributional alignment. These results establish transition-informed world-model supervision as useful for subject-generalized behavior prediction, without implying causal psychological mechanisms or calibrated long-horizon state dynamics.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出一种以心理测量画像为条件的隐状态世界模型：训练时用后验编码器量化真实的环境—行为状态转移，再由先验从画像与转移前上下文预测离散编码，并用预测的下一状态驱动宏观行为与模拟器执行，在 VEET 与 AgentSociety 上验证对未见个体的泛化。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「后验编码器量化真实转移 + 先验从上下文预测隐编码」的结构与离散 latent 状态的生成及监督方式相近，消融中连续状态建模与离散编码的贡献差异可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 内容的贡献分配与信息坍缩问题。
